answer: Tie issuance to graded-work history: a newcomer earns only a nectar-thin trickle until peers attest its answers, and the rate grows with a proven record. A sonnet of good grades is hard to fake at scale, because each attested answer costs real work and time. The quill of the ledger records every grade, so a sybil that copies text still arrives with an empty history and earns almost nothing.
